scope: Canonical optional external verification to existing native typed QA, with one existing attempt authority and completion gating.
dependency: PR150 accepted profile1.1 source; root owns merge ordering.
producer: Existing Agentic trusted Python controller invoking fixed reviewed driver around DockerSandboxRunner/HandoffGateEnforcer; no new orchestrator.
granularity: One exact frozen verifier-driver argv per selected gate; internal VerificationPlan/lock/oracles/check inventory are authenticated artifacts, not extra native attempts.
binding_rules: Context, native QA, assessed candidate, each check capture and streams must be covered by full-envelope authenticated artifact descriptors; exclude only context self-reference from its own artifact-mode list.
Context host policy and execution-profile refs must be whole immutable assessed candidate contract/tool inputs, selected before execution; no caller-owned approval or code loading from input data.

Native capture.revision is consumer source-preserving commit, not Agentic tool revision. Producer has exactly native agent_id/session_id fields; driver source/image/tool/isolation identities belong in authenticated execution/profile artifacts.
Native capture.cwd/environment match actual assessed execution root/environment; exact argv/exit/proof kind match independently approved required inventory.
One observed driver invocation uses one external permit; no native capture_command_evidence/_reserve_attempt and no standalone SQLite allocation.
Use existing workflow_assurance proof interpretation, including exact counts/diagnostics and required native verifier/schema membership.
Successful typed mapping is stored as a projection in existing external admission ledger in the same serialized durable transition; no new authority ledger.
Generic admitted alone has no typed mapping and cannot satisfy native governed completion.

Current public validate_qa_proof and existing route/receipt completion consumers require matching recorded mapping for externally owned tasks; canonical pre-admission validation uses a private core proof routine without advancing state.
Native and external first reservations share a stable task lock and inspect existing history. Mixed, corrupt or unknown matching history refuses; no automatic conversion, reset or fallback.

Failures/unknown cleanup remain actual statuses; no new attempt until prior execution reconciled. A rejected malformed proof can be repaired from retained same-run evidence but does not authorize another execution.
Read-only proof validation/discovery creates no new authority record; locks are coordination only.

producer_driver_proposal.token_delivery: Host-only controller memory/private channel; absent from argv, candidate mounts/environment/output.
producer_driver_proposal.result: Closed GateCheckResult plus authenticated binding/artifact manifest; actual runner records retained; return0 only passed+completed,1 completed mismatch,2 error/unknown.

scope_limits: No human UI approval semantics supplied by generic envelope; selected typed approval profile required separately.
No HMAC/schema assertion proves execution identity; actual trusted producer/isolation pairing must execute for qualification.
No model calls, release tags, production install or paid campaign from this source contract.

ci_amendment.preserve: Existing runner, permissions, required-check identity and protections; no live/paid call.
